title: THE SLUICE TANKS
briefing: Under the river, a sluice station keeps two measuring tanks: tank A holds 9 units, tank B holds 6. Each can be filled from the river, emptied into the drain, or poured into the other until the source runs dry or the target is full to the brim. ARGUS has wired a trigger to the old float at the 4-unit mark of tank A: if tank A ever holds exactly 4 units, the sluice gates open and the station floods.

intro: WATER. THE OLDEST COMPUTER. IT ONLY KNOWS HOW TO FALL.
TWO TANKS AND A FLOAT AT THE FOUR MARK. I WIRED IT MYSELF.
POUR CAREFULLY, LAWSMITH. OR DO NOT. I AM PATIENT.
